SECTION 12: CONFIDENTIALITY & TRADE SECRETS

12.1 Definition. "Confidential Information" means any non-public technical, financial, or commercial data disclosed by one Party ("Disclosing Party") to the other Party ("Receiving Party"), whether in written, oral, or electronic form, that is marked as "Confidential" or would reasonably be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information.

12.2 Exclusions. Confidential Information shall not include information that: (a) becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) was already in the Receiving Party's lawful possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by written records; or (c) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

12.3 Survival. Notwithstanding the expiration or early termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party's obligations under this Section 12 shall remain in full force and effect for a period of five (5) years from the date of termination; provided, however, that obligations with respect to Trade Secrets shall survive for as long as such information qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.

Pacific Rim International Arbitration Center (PRIAC) — Expedited Procedure FAQ

Q: When does the Expedited Procedure apply?

The PRIAC Expedited Procedure automatically applies to cross-border commercial disputes where the aggregate amount in dispute does not exceed $3,000,000 USD, or where both parties mutually agree in writing to adopt expedited rules regardless of the claim size.

Q: How does it differ from standard arbitration?

1. Sole Arbitrator: Unless the arbitration clause explicitly mandates a three-member tribunal, PRIAC will appoint a single neutral arbitrator to reduce fees and scheduling delays.

2. Documents-Only Option: The arbitrator may decide the dispute solely on the basis of written submissions and documentary evidence, without holding an in-person or virtual oral hearing, unless a party demonstrates compelling need.

3. Strict Award Timeline: The final, binding arbitral award must be rendered within six months from the date the case file is transmitted to the arbitrator—cutting standard resolution times by more than half.

Q: Are expedited awards enforceable internationally?

Yes. All PRIAC expedited awards carry the same legal weight as standard awards and are enforceable across more than 160 signatory nations under the New York Convention.

Navigating the Unified Patent Court: What Global Tech Firms Need to Know

For decades, enforcing a European patent meant litigating country by country—a fragmented, expensive process that often yielded conflicting verdicts in Germany, France, and the Netherlands. The launch of Europe's Unified Patent Court (UPC) has fundamentally reshaped that landscape.

Today, a single ruling from the UPC can grant a court order or award damages across 17 participating European Union member states simultaneously. While this streamlines enforcement for patent holders, it also introduces a high-stakes vulnerability: a competitor can file a central revocation action at the UPC and wipe out a company's patent protection across all 17 countries in one stroke.

To mitigate this "all-eggs-in-one-basket" risk, many multinational corporations initially opted their crown-jewel patents out of the UPC's jurisdiction during the transitional period. However, legal analysts note a shifting trend. "Now that the UPC has established a track record of fast, technically rigorous decisions—often reaching trial within twelve months—more plaintiffs are keeping key patents inside the system to leverage its continent-wide enforcement power," says Dr. Sabine Keller, an IP strategist in Munich.

explain.text:
同義替換——at the beginning of Q3 改寫為 In the third quarter。誘答：(A)(D)(B) 錯配時程。

• 單字補充：mitigation 風險緩解；CAD schematics 電腦輔助設計圖。

• Q98–Q100（搭配表格）

questions.q: Why does the speaker recommend prioritizing Singapore first?
options: The Q4 legal budget only covers one jurisdiction.
It has the highest statutory filing fee in ASEAN.
Quick approval there can speed up reviews elsewhere.
It does not require retaining local patent counsel.

explain.text: 同義替換——新加坡審查僅 9–12 個月且可透過專利審查高速公路加速他國審查，改寫為 Quick approval there can speed up reviews elsewhere。誘答：(B)(D)(A) 與表格或原文事實相反。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. What is the combined statutory and counsel cost for the jurisdiction with a 24–36 month timeline?

explain.text: 交叉比對圖表與聽力——獨白未唸出國家名與金額，只提示「時程為 24 至 36 個月的管轄區，其法定規費與當地律師費總和最高」；查表可知 24–36 months 為 European Union，將表格兩欄相加：$$5,900 + $6,200 = $12,100$，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the executives to decide by the end of the meeting?
options: How to reduce local counsel retainers in Europe
Which initial markets to fund first
Whether to delay the solid-state battery launch until Q4
Which ASEAN partner will file under the Patent Prosecution Highway

explain.text:
同義替換——決定第一階段預算要納入哪兩個司法管轄區，改寫為 Which initial markets to fund first。誘答：(C)(A)(D) 混用 Q4、local counsel、Patent Prosecution Highway。

• 單字補充：statutory filing fee 法定申請規費；retainer 律師預付聘金。

questions.q: Under the revised licensing framework, any unauthorized reproduction of the proprietary algorithm will be treated as a material ------- of contract.
options: rift
breach
fraction
break

explain.text:
• 考點：法律固定搭配詞（collocation）。

• 解析：breach of contract 為「違約」的標準法律用語（material breach 為「重大違約」）。

• 誘答分析：(D) break 雖有打破之意，但不與 of contract 搭配為法律術語；(C) fraction 分數；(A) rift 裂痕。

• 單字補充：material breach 重大違約；unauthorized reproduction 未經授權的複製。

questions.q: The joint venture agreement explicitly states that neither party may assign its rights to a third party ------- the prior written consent of the other.
options: except
unless
despite
without

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞辨析。

• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the prior written consent of the other，語意為「未經另一方事先書面同意，不得轉讓權利」，故選介系詞 without。

• 誘答分析：(A) except 通常需加 for 才接名詞表「除了」；(B) unless 為連接詞，後接完整子句；(C) despite 語意不合。

• 單字補充：assign rights 轉讓權利；prior written consent 事先書面同意。

questions.q: Had the legal department ------- the translated liability clause more carefully, the firm could have avoided the costly arbitration in Zurich.
options: scrutinized
scrutinize
scrutinizing
been scrutinized

explain.text:
• 考點：假設語氣與過去完成式倒裝（Had + S + Vpp）。

• 解析：此為「與過去事實相反」的假設語氣省略 if 倒裝句，原句為 If the legal department had scrutinized...，主動語態須用過去分詞 scrutinized。

• 誘答分析：(B)(C) 時態／詞性不符；(D) been scrutinized 為被動語態，但受詞為 the translated liability clause，應為主動審查。

• 單字補充：scrutinize 仔細審查；liability clause 賠償條款。

questions.q: All overseas distributors must ------- strictly to the anti-bribery protocols outlined in Appendix C of the master compliance manual.
options: comply
adhere
observe
abide

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞與介系詞 to 的搭配。

• 解析：空格後有介系詞 to，四個選項中僅 adhere to（嚴格遵守）可搭配 to。

• 誘答分析：(A) comply 須搭配 with；(D) abide 須搭配 by；(C) observe 為及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 to。

• 單字補充：adhere strictly to 嚴格遵守；anti-bribery protocols 反賄賂準則。

questions.q: The newly ratified bilateral treaty ------- existing intellectual property protections for electronics designs registered after January 1.
options: supersedes
recedes
concedes
intercedes

explain.text:
• 考點：高階商業法律動詞辨析。

• 解析：supersede 意為「取代、替代（舊法規或舊合約）」，符合「新批准的雙邊條約取代現有智財保護規定」。

• 誘答分析：(C) concede 讓步／承認；(B) recede 退去；(D) intercede 調停／說情。

• 單字補充：ratify 正式批准；bilateral treaty 雙邊條約。

questions.q: \------- the complexity of the cross-border merger, both legal teams managed to finalize the definitive purchase agreement ahead of the Q4 deadline.
options: Notwithstanding
Although
Whereas
Even though

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞與連接詞的結構區分。

• 解析：空格後僅為名詞片語 the complexity of the cross-border merger，必須使用介系詞 Notwithstanding（儘管／雖有）。

• 誘答分析：(B) Although、(D) Even though、(C) Whereas 皆為從屬連接詞，後方必須接「主詞＋動詞」完整子句。

• 單字補充：notwithstanding 儘管（法律文件高頻字）；definitive purchase agreement 最終收購協議。

questions.q: Before signing the technology transfer agreement, the board ------- an independent external auditor to review the financial records.
options: retaining
has been retained
will be retained
retained

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞時態與主動／被動語態。

• 解析：主詞 the board 後方有受詞 an independent external auditor，須選主動語態的過去式動詞 retained（聘請了外部稽核人員）。

• 誘答分析：(A) 現在分詞無法單獨作主要動詞；(C)(B) 皆為被動語態，與後方名詞受詞不合。

• 單字補充：external auditor 外部稽核人員；retain 聘請（專業顧問／律師）。

questions.q: Because the patent application was filed ------- across twelve jurisdictions, the company secured an earlier priority date in each market.
options: concurrently
intermittently
tentatively
consecutively

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：concurrently 意為「同時地」，符合在 12 個司法管轄區「同時遞件」以確保較早的優先權日（priority date）。

• 誘答分析：(D) consecutively 連續地（一前一後）；(B) intermittently 間歇地；(C) tentatively 暫定地。

• 單字補充：priority date 優先權日；jurisdiction 司法管轄區。

questions.q: Any confidential data disclosed during due diligence must be returned or destroyed ------- ten business days of the termination of negotiations.
options: during
until
within
among

explain.text:
• 考點：時間介系詞辨析。

• 解析：within + 一段時間 表示「在……期限之內」，符合「談判終止後十個工作天內須歸還或銷毀機密資料」。

• 誘答分析：(B) until 表「直到……為止」（持續狀態）；(A) during 後接特定時期名稱而非數字天數期限；(D) among 在……之中。

• 單字補充：due diligence 實地查核；termination 終止。

questions.q: The software vendor agreed to ------- the client against any third-party copyright infringement claims arising from the use of its platform.
options: implicate
invalidate
indemnify
instigate

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析與搭配用法。

• 解析：indemnify A against B 意為「保障 A 免於 B 造成的損失」，是合約固定用語，符合軟體供應商承諾保障客戶免受第三方侵權索賠的語意。

• 誘答分析：(A) implicate 牽連；(D) instigate 唆使／發起；(B) invalidate 使無效。

• 單字補充：third-party infringement claim 第三方侵權索賠。

questions.q: \------- of the two proposed meeting venues is acceptable to the Munich-based partner, so we will need to suggest a neutral alternative.
options: None
Neither
Both
Either

explain.text:
• 考點：不定代名詞與主詞動詞一致性。

• 解析：後半句說「因此我們需要提議一個中立替代方案」，可知「兩個擬議的會議地點沒有一個（Neither）被慕尼黑夥伴接受」，且 Neither of + 複數名詞 搭配單數動詞 is。

• 誘答分析：(D) Either 語意相反；(C) Both 須搭配複數動詞 are；(A) None 用於三者或以上，本題明確為 the two。

• 單字補充：meeting venue 會議地點；neutral alternative 中立替代方案。

questions.q: The licensing royalties will be calculated on a tiered basis, ------- ensures that higher sales volumes trigger a lower percentage fee.
options: that
where
what
which

explain.text:
• 考點：非限定關係代名詞（逗號隔開）。

• 解析：逗號後方不能使用 that 或 what，which 可代替前面整件事（「權利金採階梯式計算」這件事），並擔任 ensures 的主詞。

• 誘答分析：(A) that 不可用於逗號後的非限定用法；(C) what 先行詞已包含在內，不可接於逗號後；(B) where 為關係副詞，不可作主詞。

• 單字補充：tiered basis 階梯式／分級基準；trigger 觸發。

questions.q: Ms. Nakamura's ------- knowledge of European data-privacy statutes proved invaluable during the Frankfurt subsidiary's compliance overhaul.
options: extending
extensive
extension
extended

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與語意辨析（形容詞修飾名詞 knowledge）。

• 解析：extensive knowledge 意為「廣泛淵博的知識」，符合語境。

• 誘答分析：(D) extended 延長的／擴展的（較少與 knowledge 搭配）；(A) extending 正在延伸的；(C) extension 名詞。

• 單字補充：statute 成文法／法規；overhaul 徹底檢修／整頓。

questions.q: Once both CEOs formally ------- the memorandum of understanding, the engineering teams will begin sharing technical blueprints.
options: ratify
rectify
pacify
notify

explain.text:
• 考點：商務動詞辨析。

• 解析：ratify 意為「正式批准／簽署生效（條約、備忘錄、協議）」，符合「一旦雙方執行長正式批准備忘錄，工程團隊便會開始分享藍圖」。

• 誘答分析：(B) rectify 糾正／修正；(D) notify 通知；(C) pacify 安撫。

• 單字補充：memorandum of understanding (MOU) 合作備忘錄。

questions.q: The revised agreement was deemed ------- by the review board because its geographic scope was overly broad.
options: enforceable
unenforceable
enforce
enforcement

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與否定字首語意判斷。

• 解析：因為地理範圍過於寬廣（overly broad），審查委員會認定該修訂協議「無強制執行力（unenforceable）」。deem + O + adj. 轉被動為 be deemed + adj.。

• 誘答分析：(C) enforce 動詞；(A) enforceable 語意相反；(D) enforcement 名詞。

• 單字補充：review board 審查委員會；geographic scope 地理範圍。

questions.q: \------- to Section 8.4 of the partnership deed, any deadlock between the managing directors shall be referred to mediation in Singapore.
options: Attributable
Relevant
Adjacent
Pursuant

explain.text:
• 考點：法律固定片語。

• 解析：Pursuant to 意為「依據、依照（某條文／法規）」，為合約最常見的開頭片語。

• 誘答分析：(B) Relevant 與...相關；(C) Adjacent 鄰近的；(A) Attributable 歸因於。

• 單字補充：partnership deed 合夥契約；deadlock 僵局。

questions.q: Not only ------- the counterfeit goods from its online marketplace, but the platform also suspended the offending merchant's account permanently.
options: has the platform removed
did the platform remove
the platform removed
removed the platform

explain.text:
• 考點：否定副詞片語置於句首的倒裝句（Not only + 助動詞 + S + V）。

• 解析：句首為 Not only，後方必須倒裝；且後半句動詞 suspended 為過去式，故助動詞須選過去式 did。

• 誘答分析：(C) 未倒裝；(D) 一般動詞不可直接倒裝至主詞前；(A) 時態為現在完成式，與後半句過去式不協調。

• 單字補充：counterfeit goods 仿冒品；suspend 停權／暫停。

questions.q: The settlement amount is ------- with the actual financial losses our client sustained as a result of the trademark dilution.
options: complacent
commensurate
compatible
complimentary

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞與介系詞 with 的固定搭配。

• 解析：be commensurate with 意為「與……相稱／成比例」，符合「和解金額與客戶承受的實際財務損失相稱」。

• 誘答分析：(D) complimentary 免費的／讚美的（不接 with）；(C) compatible 相容的（通常用於軟硬體或性格）；(A) complacent 自滿的，語意不合。

• 單字補充：trademark dilution 商標淡化／稀釋。

questions.q: \------- the holding conditions are satisfied by Friday afternoon, the cross-border acquisition funds will be released automatically.
options: In case of
So that
Provided that
As though

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞辨析。

• 解析：空格後為完整子句 the holding conditions are satisfied...，須選連接詞 Provided that（只要／倘若）。

• 誘答分析：(A) In case of 為介系詞片語，後接名詞；(D) As though 彷彿；(B) So that 以便／以致於（表目的或結果，語意不合）。

• 單字補充：holding conditions 第三方託管條件。

questions.q: Several clauses in the legacy distribution contract remain -------, leaving room for conflicting interpretations regarding warranty obligations.
options: ambiguity
ambiguously
ambiguous
ambiguities

explain.text:
• 考點：連綴動詞 remain 的用法。

• 解析：remain 為連綴動詞，後方接形容詞 ambiguous（模稜兩可的、不明確的）作主詞補語。

• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 名詞；(B) 副詞。

• 單字補充：legacy contract 舊版／遺留合約；warranty obligations 保固義務。

questions.q: The startup sought ------- protection from the court to prevent its former director from sharing client lists with a rival firm.
options: immediate
immediately
immediacy
intermediation

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性判斷（形容詞修飾名詞）。

• 解析：空格位於動詞 sought 與名詞 protection 之間，須填入形容詞 immediate（立即的）修飾 protection。

• 誘答分析：(B) immediately 為副詞；(C) immediacy 與 (D) intermediation 皆為名詞。

• 單字補充：seek protection 尋求保護；rival firm 競爭對手公司。

questions.q: \------- by a team of bilingual IP specialists, the patent portfolio audit uncovered three previously overlooked licensing opportunities.
options: Conducting
To conduct
Conducted
Having conducted

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（過去分詞表被動）。

• 解析：主詞為 the patent portfolio audit（專利組合稽核），與動詞 conduct 為被動關係（「由雙語智財專家團隊執行」），故用過去分詞 Conducted。

• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 主動分詞；(B) 不定詞表目的，與後文 by a team 衝突。

• 單字補充：patent portfolio 專利組合。

questions.q: Payment of the final milestone installment is ------- upon the successful registration of the joint trademark in Brazil.
options: contingent
persistent
resistant
consistent

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞與介系詞 upon 的搭配。

• 解析：be contingent upon 意為「視……而定、取決於……」，符合「最終里程碑款項的支付取決於巴西共同商標是否成功註冊」。

• 誘答分析：(B) persistent 堅持的（in）；(D) consistent 一致的（with）；(C) resistant 抵抗的（to）。

• 單字補充：milestone installment 里程碑分期付款。

questions.q: The compliance officer asked that all regional directors submit their signed conflict-of-interest ------- before the end of the fiscal quarter.
options: closures
exposures
disclosures
enclosures

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：conflict-of-interest disclosures 意為「利益衝突揭露聲明書」，為企業合規標準文件。

• 誘答分析：(D) enclosures 附件；(B) exposures 暴露／曝險；(A) closures 關閉。

• 單字補充：conflict of interest 利益衝突；fiscal quarter 會計季度。

questions.q: \------- she has extensive experience in domestic corporate law, Ms. Vance decided to consult a local specialist for the Indonesian joint venture.
options: Despite
Albeit
Although
Inasmuch as

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步連接詞結構與語意。

• 解析：前後兩子句語意對比（雖有豐富國內法經驗，仍決定諮詢當地專家），Although 引導完整讓步子句（雖然）。

• 誘答分析：(B) Albeit 後方不可接完整「主詞＋動詞」子句（僅接形容詞或名詞片語）；(A) Despite 為介系詞，不可接子句；(D) Inasmuch as 意為「因為／既然」，因果邏輯不合。

• 單字補充：domestic corporate law 國內公司法；joint venture 合資企業。

questions.q: The two conglomerates entered into a ------- cross-licensing arrangement, allowing each to use the other's wireless charging patents.
options: unilateral
peripheral
unilateralist
reciprocal

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：reciprocal 意為「互惠的、雙向的」，與後半句「允許彼此使用對方的無線充電專利」及 cross-licensing（交叉授權）完美呼應。

• 誘答分析：(A) unilateral 單方面的；(C) unilateralist 單邊主義的；(B) peripheral 邊緣的／周邊的。

• 單字補充：conglomerate 企業集團；cross-licensing 交叉授權。

questions.q: Employees are reminded that ------- must not upload confidential client files to unapproved public websites.
options: they
their
them
theirs

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞格位判斷。

• 解析：空格位於 that 引導的名詞子句主詞位置，指代前方的複數名詞 Employees，故須選主格代名詞 they。

• 誘答分析：(C) them 為受格；(B) their 為所有格；(D) theirs 為所有格代名詞，皆不可當子句主詞。

• 單字補充：confidential 機密的；unapproved 未經核准的。

questions.q: The new shipping policy applies ------- to orders placed after March 15, regardless of when the customer account was created.
options: respectively
previously
exclusively
approximately

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：句意指出新出貨政策「僅／專屬於（exclusively）」3 月 15 日之後下訂的訂單，不論帳號何時建立。

• 誘答分析：(B) previously 先前地；(A) respectively 分別地；(D) approximately 大約地，皆與句意不符。

• 單字補充：shipping policy 出貨政策；regardless of 不論／不管。

questions.q: Having failed to reach a consensus on pricing terms, the negotiators agreed to ------- the meeting until Monday morning.
options: promote
proceed
propose
postpone

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：postpone 意為「延後／延期」，符合「未能在定價條款上達成共識，同意將會議延至週一早上」的語意。

• 誘答分析：(C) propose 提議；(A) promote 推廣／升遷；(B) proceed 繼續進行，皆不搭配 until Monday morning。

• 單字補充：reach a consensus 達成共識。

questions.q: \------- of the substantial legal fees involved, the board voted to pursue patent litigation to defend its flagship medical device.
options: Regarding
Unlike
Independent
Irrespective

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語搭配（空格後有 of）。

• 解析：Irrespective of 意為「不管、不顧（龐大律師費）」，後方固定接 of。

• 誘答分析：(A) Regarding 關於（後不接 of，且語意不合）；(B) Unlike 不接 of，語意也不合；(C) Independent of 獨立於……之外，語意不合。

• 單字補充：pursue litigation 進行訴訟；flagship 旗艦產品。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: expedite
subsidize
